messages:
Tom - AE: Heads up — prospect (Acme Health) asking for private on-prem pricing for a 12-month POC + production commit. Need guidance on platform fee + support tier pricing. POC: 2 GPUs reserved, may scale to 10 in prod. Any blockers? @Raj @Maria
Raj - Solutions Eng: Do we have a standard quote for VPC/on-prem? Last I used: one-time platform install + monthly platform fee + support. I'll paste rough numbers.
Raj - Solutions Eng: ```
One-time install: $50k
Platform recurring (per month): $8k (up to 4 GPUs), $15k (5-10 GPUs)
Support: Standard 10% ARR, Enterprise 18% ARR (SLA, 24/7)
Optional: Onsite deploy fee $10k
```
Maria - Finance: Numbers look high-level. Need to map to deal desk rate card and commit discounts. For a 12m, 10 GPU commit, we can offer 15% off platform recurring and waive onsite fee. Need ARR calc though.
Tom - AE: They're asking for a discounted platform + a reduced support fee (from 18% to 12%) for the POC + extended eval. Also want KMS/HSM integration and SOC2 evidence. Willing to sign 12m MSA with 6m evaluation clause.
Priya - Legal: SOC2 docs and KMS integration are fine. Add standard security annex. For 6m eval clause, we typically need a minimum commit for prod trigger. We should avoid making support fee permanent without deal desk OK.
Ben - Sales Ops: I'll open a Deal Desk ticket. Need the target ARR, list price, requested discount breaks, and customer logo. Also note any technical dependencies (on-prem windows? air-gapped?).
Tom - AE: Target ARR if moved to prod: ~$600k/year. Requesting 25% overall discount (platform + support) during POC -> then 15% on conversion. Air-gapped on-prem, using customer KMS. Customer prefers annual billing.
Olivia - Platform Eng: Air-gapped installs add complexity; estimated integration engineering hours ~120h. We can include a one-time engineering credit of 40h. For KMS/HSM support, we need their KMS vendor details.
Raj - Solutions Eng: Also note: Private installs have separate SLA depending on support tier. Enterprise support includes hot-fix channel and prioritized rollback. Will need to confirm RTO/RPO.
DealBot: Deal Desk ticket #DD-2025-349 created by Ben. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DD-2025-349
Ben - Sales Ops: Asking Deal Desk for 20% max discount on platform recurring + ability to reduce support to 12% for first 6 months. Approvals required from RevOps and Finance.
Maria - Finance: Approve conditional: 20% max, waive onsite fee, 40h eng credit. Any more concessions require exec signoff.
Tom - AE: Thanks all. I'll send updated commercial terms to the customer: 12m MSA, 6m eval with defined success metrics, platform fee recurring at $15k/mo pre-discount (adjusted per actual GPU count) after discounts, support at 12% for trial then 15% on conversion. Will ping once they reply.
